weakens_existing_coverage.instructions: The diff removes/weakens existing coverage (deletes assertions, loosens expected values, disables a test, strict->weak assertion).

criteria.true: existing coverage is removed or weakened
criteria.false: existing coverage is not removed or weakened

coincides_with_runtime_change.instructions: The weakening coincides with a runtime behavior change in the same PR (not a pure test-only refactor).

criteria.true: weakening coincides with a runtime behavior change

guarded_security_or_regression.instructions: The weakened test guarded a security-relevant path or a prior-bug regression.

criteria.true: the weakened test guarded a security/regression path
